summary: AstroSync AI is an advanced telemetry compression and reconstruction protocol designed for the Lunar Landing Site Navigator challenge. By utilizing pre-synchronized reference mapping templates stored locally on spacecraft and ground stations, AstroSync AI completely eliminates spatial coordinate metadata overhead. This compresses deep-space data transmission times from a standard 24-hour cycle down to just 30–55 minutes, enabling real-time topographical evaluation. The system maintains an exceptional Root Mean Square Error (RMSE < 0.0450) and ensures extreme resilience by successfully recovering full surface structure even under 30% packet loss corruption and sensor thermal noise.
details:
AstroSync AI is an interactive telemetry simulation and reconstruction protocol built for the Lunar Landing Site Navigator challenge.

- What it does: Eliminates spatial coordinate metadata overhead using pre-synchronized reference mapping templates, compressing deep-space transmission cycles from 24 hours down to 30-55 minutes.

- Tech Stack: Python, Streamlit, NumPy, SciPy, Plotly.

- Code & Demo: Explore the full source code, scripts, and documentation on our GitHub repository: https://github.com/rakeshchoudhary71987-design/astrasync-ai
